s1.syndrome_frame: Acute cardiogenic shock with multiorgan failure and severely impaired left ventricular systolic function
salient_findings: Severely impaired left ventricular systolic function
Akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction
key_facts: 47-year-old man
Underwent excision of a benign thyroglossal duct cyst
Experienced recurrent hypertensive episodes during surgery
Developed profound hypotension and pulmonary oedema after extubation
Transthoracic echocardiography showed severely impaired left ventricular systolic function
Coronary angiography revealed no evidence of relevant coronary artery disease
Toxicological screening was negative
Medical history included chronic polyarthritis and treated arterial hypertension
Invasively ventilated with PaO2/FiO2 30 mmHg
Receiving norepinephrine at 2.5 µg/kg/min
Blood pressure was 75/49 mmHg
Heart rate 180 b.p.m.
Bilateral rales and basal dullness on chest percussion
Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling

shortlist.label: Myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis

shortlist.label: Reverse takotsubo cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Bedside echocardiography demonstrated akinesia of all basal and mid LV segments with preserved apical contraction

shortlist.label: Stress-induced cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient experienced recurrent hypertensive episodes during surgery and developed profound hypotension and pulmonary oedema after extubation

shortlist.label: Postoperative cardiogenic shock
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed cardiogenic shock after undergoing excision of a benign thyroglossal duct cyst

shortlist.label: Chronic active myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling

raw.rationale: Endomyocardial biopsy revealed moderate chronically active myocarditis with diffuse interstitial remodelling, which directly explains the severely impaired left ventricular systolic function and the clinical presentation of cardiogenic shock.

rejected.label: Myocarditis
rejected.why: Too broad, as the biopsy specified 'chronically active' myocarditis

rejected.label: Reverse takotsubo cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Although suspected based on echocardiography findings, the biopsy results indicate a chronic process rather than an acute stress-induced condition

rejected.label: Stress-induced cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Similar to reverse takotsubo cardiomyopathy, this is an acute condition that does not account for the chronic changes seen on biopsy

rejected.label: Postoperative cardiogenic shock
rejected.why: This is a descriptive term for the patient's condition but does not provide a specific diagnosis for the underlying cause of the cardiogenic shock

rejected.label: Reverse takotsubo cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Already considered and rejected due to biopsy results indicating a chronic process
